notes: WORKED OUT, NOT PUBLISHED. The ONS publishes London's overseas visits by quarter only. Each month here is London's 2025 quarter shared out in the proportions the UK's visits fell across that quarter's three months: London in month m = London's quarter x (the UK's month m / the UK's quarter). The three months of a quarter sum back to London's quarter (up to the rounding to 1,000).

The UK's monthly pattern is 2023's, not 2025's: the ONS has published no month after June 2024. 2023 is the latest calendar year published monthly in full and as final estimates; Easter fell in April in 2023 as in 2025 (in March in 2024), so the March and April shares compare.

What it assumes: London's visits fall across a quarter's months as the UK's did in 2023. A London-only event (a month heavier in London than in the rest of the UK) cannot show. The quarters are provisional, under the survey's new design.
Every row keeps both inputs (London's quarter, the UK's month and quarter) and the unrounded result in `inputs`. Raw files and their URLs: data/raw/uk5-visitors/SOURCES.md.
